updateDefinitions.name: HVM Cluster 1.2 Upgrade
updateDefinitions.description:
# HVM Cluster 1.2 Upgrade

This upgrade transitions your cluster from **MVM 1.1** to **HVM Cluster 1.2** with Ubuntu 24.04 LTS support.

## What This Upgrade Does

### Operating System Upgrade
- **Verifies** all hosts are running Ubuntu 24.04 LTS
- **Performs in-place upgrade** from Ubuntu 22.04 to 24.04 if needed
- Ensures kernel compatibility and system packages are current

### Branding & Configuration Updates
- Updates cluster branding from **MVM** to **HVM Clusters**
- Migrates to HVM 1.2 cluster layout configuration
- Updates cluster management interfaces and labels

### Security & Runtime Configuration
- **AppArmor profiles** updated for Ubuntu 24.04 compatibility
- **QEMU run users** configured with proper permissions
- System security policies aligned with HVM 1.2 standards

## Maintenance Requirements

⚠️ **This upgrade requires maintenance mode on all hosts**

- Each host will be placed into maintenance mode during the upgrade
- Hosts will be upgraded in a **rolling rotation** to maintain cluster availability
- Workloads will be migrated off hosts during their maintenance window
- Estimated downtime per host: 15-30 minutes

## Before You Begin

- [ ] Ensure all cluster hosts are healthy and operational
- [ ] Verify sufficient storage and memory capacity for workload migration
- [ ] Confirm backup procedures are current
- [ ] Review maintenance window scheduling with your team
- [ ] Ensure network connectivity is stable across all hosts

## Upgrade Process

1. **Pre-flight checks** validate cluster health
2. **First host** enters maintenance mode and upgrades
3. **Workload migration** to remaining hosts
4. **OS and configuration updates** applied
5. **Validation** of host functionality
6. **Process repeats** for each remaining host
7. **Post-upgrade verification** of cluster health

---

**Note:** This is a major version upgrade. Please ensure you have reviewed the HVM Cluster 1.2 release notes and validated your environment meets all prerequisites.
